notes: Access route: direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/interstitial); robots.txt has only standard account/checkout/api disallows, no ClaudeBot-specific block. Site is an Angular-SSR storefront (Shopware backend + Contentful CMS marketing content) under www.depot-online.de/de/c/<slug>; no sitemap.xml at the expected path, category tree discovered by crawling the nav (top bar: Herbst, Balkon & Garten, Inspiration, Neu, Deko/Deko & Wohnen, Textilien, Tisch & Kueche, Moebel, Geschenke & Party, Anlaesse, ipuro, Sale) and each category page's child-category tiles. Counts verified via the rendered 'Ergebnisse anzeigen (N) / N Artikel' header, which was confirmed STABLE and TOTAL (not per-page): re-fetched Kerzenstaender & Kerzenhalter at ?page=2 and the header still showed the same total (69), and children sums matched or nearly matched parents (Tablett 26 + Schale 5 = 31 = Tabletts & Schalen parent exactly; Kerzenstaender & Kerzenhalter 69 + Teelichthalter/Windlichter/Laternen 49 = 118 vs parent 117, off by 1 likely a dual-tagged product - both treated as verified). Rule 0 gains: included the full 'Beleuchtung & Brunnen' (outdoor lighting) branch under Balkon & Garten - Outdoor Fairy Lights (2), Solar Lights/Light Objects/Lanterns (19), outdoor Windlights & Lanterns (26) - which a room/location-based skip rule would have dropped as 'garden' items; also kept Outdoor Vases & Decor Accessories (41) and Outdoor Tableware (glassware/plates, 35+27) from the Balkon & Garten branch under Rule 0.6 even though they overlap in product type with the indoor Vasen/Deko-Accessoires and Gedeckter-Tisch/Hausbar branches - documented here as genuine separate site nav branches (different URLs, different product populations, both real listing pages), not a facet re-cut. EXCLUDED as facet/material/color re-cuts per Rule 1 guidance (verified via product-ID-population subset checks, not names): Kerzenstaender-Glas/-Gold/-Holz/-Schwarz/-Silber (5 material/colour landing pages under Kerzenstaender & Kerzenhalter), Vasen color/size/shape variants (vase-beige/-schwarz/-weiss, kleine-vasen, glasvasen, ballonvasen, trend-deko-vasen), and Holztablett (wood-material subset of Tablett, confirmed 9 of 26). EXCLUDED as out-of-scope: Blumen branch in full (Blumen-Girlanden, Blumenkraenze, Blumenstraeusse, Einzelblumen-Blueten, Kunstpflanzen - all artificial/faux flowers per explicit exclusion rule); Weitere Home-Accessoires branch (Aufbewahrung=storage, Basteln & Streuartikel=crafts, Hobbies & Lifestyle, Kinderland=kids, Badezimmer/Bad-Aufbewahrung=bathroom storage); Badaccessoires (checked product titles - mixed roll-up dominated by soap dispensers, ipuro hand soap and a bathroom textile set, with only a few decor items scattered in that already exist as their own listings elsewhere - dropped as mixed roll-up per Rule 0.4/'inspect actual product titles'); Anhaenger & Girlanden (checked titles - mostly small seasonal/autumn decorative pendants plus party photo-garlands and a Halloween garland, i.e. seasonal/party-leaning mixed roll-up, dropped); Kerzen-Zubehoer (matches and USB candle lighters - functional, not decorative); Duftkerzen and Kuchenkerzen/Motivkerzen (scented candles / cake-birthday candles - Home Fragrance and party-supply exclusions); Getraenkezubehoer (drinking straws, ice-cube trays, coasters - functional bar accessories, not glassware itself); Trinkhalme (straws); Solarbrunnen & Zubehoer (checked titles - solar garden fountains plus artificial floating water-lily decor - garden water-feature/faux-botanical, not core decor); Kueche (kitchen tools/storage/sets), Tisch-Kuechentextilien, Suessigkeiten-Leckereien (food), Aufbewahrung, Outdoor-Moebel, Outdoor-Textilien, Blumentreppen-Pflanzregale, Pool-Strand, Kunstblumen-Topfpflanzen (all excluded per standard furniture/textile/storage/food/faux-plant rules). Top-level Textilien, Moebel, Geschenke & Party, Anlaesse, Herbst, Neu, Sale and ipuro (home-fragrance brand shop) were reviewed at top-nav level and excluded as textiles/furniture/gift-party/seasonal-holiday/home-fragrance, consistent with the brief's exclusion list. No standalone Clocks (Uhren) category exists on the site - a site search for 'uhr' returned 52 unrelated results (no clock products), confirming this is a genuine absence, not a missed category. Currency EUR throughout; all category/sub_category values translated from the site's German into plain English, original German node/slug names quoted in evidence for verification.
